blocks.text: To the strong friend: you're allowed to fall apart too. You don't always have to be the one with the answers, the one who checks in, the one who says "I'm fine" so nobody worries. Your heart gets tired. Let someone hold it for a while. Being strong was never supposed to mean being alone.

caption:
Check on your strong friend. She's tired too. 🖤
Tag the friend who holds everyone together.
Save this for the day you need to hear it.
